ensure: insert into "policy_owner_states" ("owner_id", "bootstrap_version", "collection_version", "created_at", "updated_at") values ($1, default, default, default, default) on conflict do nothing
eligible: select "id", "owner_id", "key_blind_index", "protected_summary", "protected_body", "enabled", "mandatory", "audience", "position", "template_key", "row_version", "created_at", "updated_at" from "policies" where ("policies"."owner_id" = $1 and "policies"."enabled" = $2 and "policies"."audience" in ($3, $4)) order by "policies"."position" asc, "policies"."id" asc
workspace: select "workspace_policy_assignments"."policy_id", "project_workspaces"."id" from "workspace_policy_assignments" inner join "project_workspaces" on ("project_workspaces"."id" = "workspace_policy_assignments"."workspace_id" and "project_workspaces"."owner_id" = $1) inner join "project_workspace_memberships" on ("project_workspace_memberships"."workspace_id" = "project_workspaces"."id" and "project_workspace_memberships"."project_id" = $2) order by "project_workspaces"."position" asc, "project_workspaces"."created_at" asc
